name: Extra Boosters
description: Adds a 22nd booster: Primed Sure Footed (no knockdowns or ragdolls for the squad, with the Primed Sure Footed mod), with its own name and description, owned and in the booster picker. Moves the game's booster table to make room. Every player in a co-op session needs it. Settings in extra-boosters.ini. GPL-3.0 (ownership code from HellForge).
